a.text: This is the girl who smashed my window?
Hrm. If she was breaking and entering, then we should confiscate everything on her and throw her out to the wastes. Those are the rules of the community.
But all she stole was a piece of dried cheese from the storeroom. Hey, you, what was your name again?
Hamelin... How about this, Hamelin: I'll toss a coin to decide your fate.
If it's tails, you'll be banished. But if it's heads, I'll let you off.

steps.name: Scavenger
steps.text: Reporting in.

steps.name: Scavenger
steps.text: Day... seven.

steps.name: Scavenger
steps.text: More deceased got disposed of this morning. Likely extreme Originium particulate density in the building. Conditions for the Infected are turning south fast.

steps.name: Scavenger
steps.text: For the past 24 hours, haven't seen any workers in any area not covered by walls, let alone leaving the factory.

steps.name: Scavenger
steps.text: Comms pick up heavy interference when I get even slightly closer.

steps.name: Scavenger
steps.text: High-voltage network all around outside. No way to locate the control room for now.

steps.name: Scavenger
steps.text: Got the exterior patrol shifts and movement patterns down. Can't work out the guards inside yet.

steps.name: Scavenger
steps.text: I want to get this crap over with. If you give the go, I can take the most violent option.

steps.name: Scavenger
steps.text: Hmph... Fine, Rhodes Island does things its own way. Copy.

steps.name: Scavenger
steps.text: Plan B? The factory's waste transporter goes down to the basement every morning at three. They stop running the sewer pipes in the meantime.

steps.name: Scavenger
steps.text: Simple enough to get through, as long as I get a gas mask.

steps.name: Scavenger
steps.text: I'm only responsible for paralyzing the security systems here, anyway. Not my job to provide followup support or guidance, right?

steps.name: Scavenger
steps.text: ...I know. I can do this less cleanly, if it comes to it. Figured that's why you called me for this in the first place.

steps.name: Scavenger
steps.text: End of report.

steps.name: Scavenger
steps.text: Insane how Rhodes Island actually wants to save Infected. What an employer.

steps.name: Scavenger
steps.text: That's the sound of the transporter starting up... It's go time.

steps.name: Factory Guard
steps.text: Ugh—

steps.name: Scavenger
steps.text: Lights out, bozo.

steps.name: Scavenger
steps.text: Security system here seems almost as complex as a prison. Whatever, it practically is one anyway.

steps.name: Scavenger
steps.text: Need to find the control room before I tip anyone off—
Watch it!

steps.name: Scavenger
steps.text: Huh?
Any further and you'll trip the automated—
—What? You?

steps.name: Scavenger
steps.text: ...Tulio.

steps.name: Tulio
steps.text: 'Scavenger'. Heh, didn't think you were still kicking.

steps.name: Tulio
steps.text: What're you doing here? Guessing you've been dragging that weapon with you through the sewer pipes, huh, li'l rat?

steps.name: Tulio
steps.text: —Hold on, lower your blade, let's talk this out. Else I'll sound the alarm.

steps.name: Tulio
steps.text: The system's linked directly to police HQ. They're gonna read any signal from here as an Infected riot.

steps.name: Scavenger
steps.text: You a guard here too?

steps.name: Tulio
steps.text: Yeah, but trust me, Scavenger—

steps.name: Scavenger
steps.text: Tch. Trust you?

steps.name: Tulio
steps.text: I'm betting we're after the same thing. I saw you knock that guy out. You're looking for a way out, aren't you?

steps.name: Tulio
steps.text: 'Cause I want out too, or else I wouldn't have stopped you just now.

steps.name: Scavenger
steps.text: Hmph.

steps.name: Tulio
steps.text: *Sigh* I'm serious, I turned a new leaf since all those years ago. Look, I'm Infected now too. I've been through hella shit, I... I understand you.

steps.name: Tulio
steps.text: You've seen this factory up close. You know how things are here, right?

steps.name: Tulio
steps.text: They call me a guard, but I'm still just as much a prisoner as anyone else. We're all just as damned here.

steps.name: Scavenger
steps.text: Okay, but you're their overseer.

steps.name: Tulio
steps.text: You know the sweet lies this place cooks up to lure in the Infected... I don't like it either, but we've all gotta get our hands dirty to survive.

steps.name: Scavenger
steps.text: You don't get any sympathy from me, sorry.

steps.name: Tulio
steps.text: Hold on, I haven't gotten to the important part. I know the systems here inside out. You can't get past them without my help.

steps.name: Tulio
steps.text: There're two watchhound cores monitoring the whole factory at the same time. Throwing the master breaker to cut the surveillance won't get you anywhere either; they'll switch to emergency power, fast.

steps.name: Tulio
steps.text: You need someone to work with you, and obviously I need someone to help me out. So no matter how much you distrust me, working together's still our best bet.

steps.name: Scavenger
steps.text: I never said I was escaping.

steps.name: Tulio
steps.text: I know you're wary of me, but—

steps.name: Scavenger
steps.text: —I'm completing shutting down this place's security system.

steps.name: Tulio
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Scavenger
steps.text: That's the job I took.

steps.name: Tulio
steps.text: What kinda merc just comes out and spills the job they're on?

steps.name: Scavenger
steps.text: Cut the crap. The sooner I'm done, the better. Tell me where the surveillance cores are located.

steps.name: Tulio
steps.text: Alright... so you're agreeing to work together, then? Is that what you mean?

steps.name: Tulio
steps.text: I know what you're planning, Scavenger. I'm not gonna tell you every route straight away.

steps.name: Tulio
steps.text: Follow me, and keep to the foot of the wall. I've figured out the blind spots.

steps.name: Scavenger
steps.text: Is the factory foreman in?

steps.name: Tulio
steps.text: He's not. Why would he be? It's three in the morning.

steps.name: Tulio
steps.text: He only shows up occasionally. What kinda healthy guy would wanna live in a place where the air's filled with Originium?

steps.name: Scavenger
steps.text: So everyone here's Infected?

steps.name: Tulio
steps.text: Yeah. Not a problem for you, right? You're already Infected, what's a couple more rocks gonna do?

steps.name: Tulio
steps.text: What about the rest of your crew? I figure they all got their protection on?

steps.name: Tulio
steps.text: What're you guys after, anyway? There's nothing valuable here, and we don't exactly make high-precision Originium products. Seriously can't figure out why anyone'd rob this place.

steps.name: Tulio
steps.text: ...Don't feel like answering, huh? You weren't this hard to talk to back when we used to do business.

steps.name: Tulio
steps.text: Although I guess you wouldn't have cut it as a merc if you were the same as before.

steps.name: Scavenger
steps.text: Don't waste your breath. Never wanted to work with a piece of shit like you, anyway.

steps.name: Tulio
steps.text: Tch...

steps.name: Tulio
steps.text: But we've got no choice for now. We have to split ways from here.

steps.name: Tulio
steps.text: Surveillance core's right over there, through the workshop.

steps.name: Scavenger
steps.text: Then we each make our move in ten minutes. I'll find you after. Once we RDV, we head to the master control room and take out the whole system.

steps.name: Scavenger
steps.text: You better have turned that new goddamn leaf.

a.text: I actually knew which side that coin would land on, the moment it fell.
Here, give me your hand. I'll teach you the trick. Like this—
It's alright, Hamelin. You might be Infected now, but you don't have to stay that far from me.
That's right, you'll be even further after today... You're leaving tomorrow morning, right?
I'm sorry. I couldn't do anything about it.
We know you got infected so the community could survive, but they won't even let you off for it... I know, you had to take that risk so we could carry on. That's how it's always been.
Take this silver coin—as a memento.
No matter where you are, no matter what happens... I'm here, and I hope you live.

steps.name: Tulio
steps.text: Base station signal screener's already off.

steps.name: Tulio
steps.text: Next, high-voltage network... down. Electric doors... open. Pulling the master breaker.

steps.name: Tulio
steps.text: Phew...

steps.name: Scavenger
steps.text: Done?—

steps.name: Scavenger
steps.text: Tch...! Knew it!

steps.name: Scavenger
steps.text: Asshole! Backstabbing me again?!

steps.name: Scavenger
steps.text: How the hell does this work out for you?

steps.name: Tulio
steps.text: Heh. Always gotta try, y'know?

steps.name: Scavenger
steps.text: Think you can get away with this? A little shit like you's never gonna fool me twice!

steps.name: Tulio
steps.text: What else am I supposed to do? Just sit back and wait for you to take me out?

steps.name: Tulio
steps.text: Neither of us needs the other now. The factory doors are wide open. Of course I'm gonna make the first move instead of being the victim.

steps.name: Scavenger
steps.text: I never said I was gonna kill you.

steps.name: Tulio
steps.text: Duh. Why would you? But in what bizarro universe does this end with you letting me the hell go?

steps.name: Tulio
steps.text: I'm Infected too. Now I can understand how desperate you were back then... and also how much you must hate me.

steps.name: Scavenger
steps.text: True... never had that many clients I could put a face to.

steps.name: Tulio
steps.text: Tch. Since when did Zalaks have this much strength?

steps.name: Scavenger
steps.text: I told you, you're not getting away with this.

steps.name: Scavenger
steps.text: Now don't move, unless you wanna get cut in half.

steps.name: Tulio
steps.text: Tch...

steps.name: Scavenger
steps.text: Let's be clear. Whether or not I kill you right now is entirely up to my mood.

steps.name: Tulio
steps.text: You... This goddamn Oripathy's making me so weak. How the hell are you still just fine?

steps.name: Tulio
steps.text: How did you pull this off? You're like a completely different person.

steps.name: Scavenger
steps.text: Hmph. Of course you wish I was still that rookie merc. Pure. Gullible.

steps.name: Scavenger
steps.text: I did the dirty work no one else was willing to, and the client never gave a damn thing in return.

steps.name: Scavenger
steps.text: I blacked out from an Oripathy attack, woke up in a ditch, and you know what I found? The few remaining things I had from home, gone, taken just like that.

steps.name: Tulio
steps.text: You were gonna die sooner or later, so I figured waste not, want not...

steps.name: Scavenger
steps.text: Heh. 'Waste not, want not.'

steps.name: Tulio
steps.text: Everyone living on the edge exploits each other like that. Isn't that the understanding?

steps.name: Tulio
steps.text: And what was I supposed to do? Wait for some Infected to die and cause a spreader event right in front of me?

steps.name: Tulio
steps.text: Who knew you'd live? And still be alive today!

steps.name: Scavenger
steps.text: Right... That's probably because I have someone who hopes I live.

steps.name: Scavenger
steps.text: When I woke up, I still had that silver coin sewn into my clothes. It was still there. That's why I decided to live on.

steps.name: Tulio
steps.text: You really know how to hang onto life, rat. What could one silver buy you?

steps.name: Scavenger
steps.text: I never spent it. Never will.

steps.name: Tulio
steps.text: Then how did you...?

steps.name: Scavenger
steps.text: The same way you got tricked into this factory, thinking there'd be a stable enough life for an Infected here. But what you got instead were vile living conditions and inhumane treatment.

steps.name: Scavenger
steps.text: What I went through didn't stop there. Might've been even worse. But that's life for you.

steps.name: Tulio
steps.text: The hell are you saying to me...? Acting like we're in the same boat.

steps.name: Scavenger
steps.text: We're all in the same goddamn boat.

steps.name: Tulio
steps.text: *Sigh*... Fine, I get it. Bet I look like the punchline of a joke to you now, huh? Must be nice, getting your revenge. No wonder you're in such a good mood.

steps.name: Scavenger
steps.text: Pssh... You think way too much.

steps.name: Tulio
steps.text: Yeah, and it's all your fault I'm in this mess anyway!

steps.name: Tulio
steps.text: Because I hired your Infected mercenary ass, it didn't take long for me to get symptoms too. I should've just stayed away from you and your kind!

steps.name: Scavenger
steps.text: Alright, get this through your skull. Touching the Infected isn't gonna give you Oripathy just like that.

steps.name: Tulio
steps.text: You think I'd believe that?

steps.name: Scavenger
steps.text: No skin off my nose if you don't, but that's my current employer's view. I've gotta tell you on their behalf.

steps.name: Scavenger
steps.text: Oh... Now I get why you wanted me to work with you, even though you were scared of me getting payback.

steps.name: Scavenger
steps.text: You were gonna have me bust you out, then dispose of me to complete this imaginary 'revenge' of yours. Your whole 'waste not, want not.'

steps.name: Tulio
steps.text: Ha, like you weren't thinking the same thing? Weren't you biding your time with me, just so you could make your move now?

steps.name: Tulio
steps.text: So why're we still blabbering? Need me to teach you how they handle the Infected they kill here?

steps.name: Scavenger
steps.text: No. I only cooperated with you so I could finish my mission a little faster.

steps.name: Scavenger
steps.text: I can cope with shitawful work environments, and that includes shitawful coworkers. I don't think the way you do.

steps.name: Scavenger
steps.text: Besides, my mission was to aid and rescue the Infected, and you're one of them.

steps.name: Tulio
steps.text: Rescue the Infected? You're shitting me.

steps.name: Scavenger
steps.text: Whatever. Ask my employer.

steps.name: Scavenger
steps.text: Reporting in.

steps.name: Scavenger
steps.text: Factory security system paralyzed, but foreman not on site.

steps.name: Scavenger
steps.text: Um, I don't care how you guys extract the Infected. Maybe you're taking them somewhere or whatever. I just wanna confirm if my mission's complete or not.

steps.name: Scavenger
steps.text: Factory guards are also Infected. You rescuing them too?

steps.name: Scavenger
steps.text: ...So, I can handle problems my own way here.

steps.name: Scavenger
steps.text: Understood. I'll withdraw to the designated site ASAP.

steps.name: Scavenger
steps.text: End of report.

steps.name: Scavenger
steps.text: Hmph. Sounds like they're actually making good on what they said.

steps.name: Scavenger
steps.text: Never imagined I'd find such a trustworthy client. Let alone anyone who takes the Infected seriously.

steps.name: Scavenger
steps.text: ...Just like how her wish could never come true.

steps.name: Scavenger
steps.text: —Anyway, you heard that. They gave me some leeway.

steps.name: Tulio
steps.text: Damn, you really don't care about anything except what your employer wants.

steps.name: Scavenger
steps.text: Think what you like. I'll toss a coin to decide your fate, then.

steps.name: Scavenger
steps.text: If it's tails, I clean up the trash here and now; if it's heads, I let you off, and give you one more chance to start over, like the other Infected.

a.text: Scavenger slides out a tiny silver coin, and flings it into the air.
Many a time, alone with no one to turn to, she's shut her eyes and entrusted it all to the result of a coin toss.
'Maybe one day, when you're not using every ounce of your strength just to survive, you'll get to decide where it is you want to go.'
She doesn't know whether a day like that comes for people like her.
But this time, she knows what the coin will answer.
